channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 21
item.description:
83 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Prevented crocodiles from dying on spawn and ensured they only spawn near rivers.

Items & Crafting

  • Adjusted bandage world model collision size and corrected its outline reference.
  • Reduced fireplace deploy volume to allow placement under existing floors.
  • Repaired corrupt hazmat suit prefab.
  • Fixed chainsaw world model highlight and reduced highlight draw count.
  • Reduced craft costs for mortar, hazmat suit, and HMLMG; made prisoner hood a default blueprint and removed it from the tech tree.

UI & HUD

  • Fixed market terminal long name rendering overflow.
  • Fixed crash when switching cameras.
  • Improved on-screen toast notifications.
  • Fixed typo and updated text for the smart alarm device.
  • Live preview of race and skin color in character customization icons; fixed preview bugs and improved tab labeling.

World & Monuments

  • Corrected collision mesh for high external wall and gate.
  • Added damage-state visual effects to all blocker objects.

Gameplay & Creatures

  • Optimized train collision handling by caching HittableByTrains owner entity, reducing lookup overhead during saves.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 20
item.description:
79 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed old scientists movement and AI getting stuck, including crouch‑walk angle on stairs and slower behavior.
  • Improved navmesh sampling to eliminate spikes from unreachable points.

Monuments & Structures

  • Deployables placed inside rooms now work via separate network groups.
  • Added a repairable helipad at the bandit camp; players must contribute resources to unlock air vehicle purchases, and it stays repaired until the next wipe.

UI & Gameplay

  • Tuned conversation readout timings for clearer dialogue pacing.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Aug 19
item.description:
88 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Navmesh and pathfinding overhaul fixes agents getting stuck, improves edge handling and performance.
  • Tiger charging behavior fixed to stop endless charging at vine trees.
  • Debug commands added to select, move, and release NPCs with adjustable speeds.

Gameplay Items & Weapons

  • Wooden loot crates now break into proper gibs and retain unique materials; Tier 2 lootbox uses its own material for gibs.
  • Flashlight weapon animation and viewmodel issues fixed; custom animator added and prop rotations corrected.
  • Salvaged hammer now has proper drop and pickup animations; AK ammo script hides bullet models when ammo is depleted.

Vehicles

  • Server error from modular car decay damage fixed; vehicle pooling resets improved and automated pooling tests added.
  • Boat UI now only shows fuel, start engine, and stop engine options for the driver; fuel interaction bug fixed.

Monuments

  • Large oil spill and other monument updates fixed, including blocker mesh issues and improved avoidance logic using PreventBuildingMonumentTag.
  • Data updated for military tunnel, oilrig, and launch site monuments.

Character Customization & UI

  • Character creator page fixed with missing inspector arguments, added tile prefabs, character preview toggle, and fixed-size flex grid cells.

Gameplay

  • Thrown darts now use pooling, fixing leaderboard tracking.
  • Pool ball data pooling logic corrected to prevent incorrect behavior.
